name: Yomitan
overview: Look up words in Japanese subtitles with Yomitan
description: Splits Japanese subtitles into words during playback in jellyfin-web, and shows Yomitan's popup for the word under the pointer, a finger or a remote. Dictionaries are uploaded once by an admin and stored on the server. Each user turns it on with a button in the player.

versions.changelog: - fix(store): restore the busy timeout even when a checkpoint throws - fix(settings): read a stored row that is not a JSON object as no row - fix(playback): refuse a track tagged with another language before fetching it - fix(import): refuse titles settings cannot hold, and keep them to one log line - fix(import): refuse lone surrogates and a zip64 directory past the end as bad input - fix(engine): announce a dictionary change with the new list in place - perf(subtitles): find overlapping karaoke syllables in one pass - fix(import): size an SVG with no usable width, height or viewBox as an does - fix(segmenter): let a phrase with a particle inside lose its ties - fix(segmenter): read Jitendex's scale and its part-of-speech codes - feat(segmenter): split the phrases JMdict lists by what their tags say they are - feat(segmenter): count kana for usually-kana words as written, and give scans tag names - fix(segmenter): keep drawn-out endings on their word, and find forms a refused match hid - fix(segmenter): count katakana that matches a reading as written - perf(client): take 800 bytes off the loader, and keep them off - fix(test): keep each title's corpus sample stable when titles are added - fix: make the feature easier to find, and four smaller UX fixes - fix: close eight gaps found in review - feat: link Yomitan's list of dictionaries from the dashboard page
